speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth whether she can provide an update on whether there has been a review of the Sports Hub public-private partnership arrangement and whether the Ministry is satisfied with the outcomes of the arrangement thus far.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: In recent years, it has hosted sports events, such as the Season of Athletics, Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation (HSBC) Singapore Rugby Sevens, and FINA Swimming World Cup.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: As an avid sports fan, I am very happy that we have all those major sporting events that are brought to Singapore.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: First, I am sure there are many learning points that the Ministry has acquired as a result of this pilot.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Would the Minister be in a position to share what these learning points are so that, for future PPP projects, this is something which we could all learn from?

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: But it will not do justice if I were to just explain or give these learning points out of memory, because this is a very substantive and serious matter.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: So, if the Member is interested, he may raise a separate Parliamentary Question.
